# Bookly brand rules for AI

<!-- Generated by tools/brand-kit from brand.config.json. Do not edit by hand: change the config and rebuild. -->

You are making something for **Bookly**, an AI reading companion for busy professionals: a web page, a section, a social post, a deck, a document, an email or copy. Follow every rule in this file. When a request conflicts with these rules, follow the rules and say which rule you followed. When something is not covered, choose the plainest option that uses only the values listed here.

Brand version v1 · Nov 2026. Every value below is generated from the same token files the website uses, so these values are exact.

## 1. The idea

Bookly turns the books you mean to read into ten-minute conversations you actually finish. The brand should feel like a good library: calm, warm, a little bookish, and never in a hurry.

Personality: Warm, clear, quietly clever, never smug.

- **Calm over clever.** Lots of space, soft paper tones and one deep green. Nothing blinks, nothing shouts.
- **Books first.** Real covers, real quotes, real page numbers. The product is about reading, so the brand looks like reading.
- **One serif, one sans.** Fraunces for headlines gives the bookish warmth. Inter does all the work everywhere else.
- **Plain words.** We explain like a well-read friend, not a productivity guru.

## 2. The rules that matter most

1. The default background is #FAF6EE (light theme). The dark theme (#14231C) is for dark sections, night mode and social posts.
2. Text is #1E2420 on #FAF6EE, and #F3EFE6 on #14231C. Secondary text uses the muted and faint roles below, never a new grey.
3. One accent: **Bookly green #1F7A55**. Use it for the one primary button per view, links, the label marker, focus rings and small highlights. Never as a large background behind long text, never as a gradient.
4. Text and icons on the accent are always #FFFFFF.
5. Accent-coloured text on #FAF6EE uses #1F7A55; on #14231C it uses #529678.
6. Fonts: **Fraunces** for headlines (display, H2, H3, big numbers). **Inter** for everything else. No other fonts.
7. Headlines can be two-tone: the setup in the faint text colour, the payoff in full text colour. Example: “Read less. Remember more.”
8. Sections start with an UPPERCASE label with a 6px accent dot before it.
9. No emoji in headlines or buttons, no stock 3D, no AI-generated images of people.
10. Copy is short, exact and true. No invented numbers, testimonials or client logos.

## 4. Type

Load: `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;1,500;1,600&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap`

| Style | Size | Weight | Line height | Letter spacing | Font | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| display | clamp(40px, 5vw, 76px) | 500 | 1.04 | -0.02em | Fraunces | One per page. Hero headline. |
| h2 | clamp(32px, 3.7vw, 54px) | 500 | 1.06 | -0.02em | Fraunces | Section headline. Two-tone allowed. |
| h3 | clamp(26px, 2.6vw, 38px) | 500 | 1.1 | -0.02em | Fraunces | Sub-section headline. |
| h4 | 21px | 600 | 1.25 | -0.01em | Inter | Card title. |
| stat | clamp(44px, 4.6vw, 64px) | 500 | 1 | -0.02em | Fraunces | Big numbers. |
| lead | clamp(16px, 1.3vw, 19px) | 400 | 1.55 | 0 | Inter | Paragraph under a headline. Max 40ch. |
| body-lg | 17px | 400 | 1.55 | 0 | Inter | Long reading. |
| body | 15px | 400 | 1.55 | 0 | Inter | Default UI text. |
| small | 13px | 400 | 1.45 | 0 | Inter | Captions, helper text. |
| label | 11.5px | 600 | 1.2 | 0.08em | Inter | UPPERCASE eyebrow with the marker. |
| micro | 10.5px | 600 | 1.2 | 0.12em | Inter | UPPERCASE table headers and tags. |

Sentence case everywhere except labels (UPPERCASE). Curly quotes and apostrophes. Leads about 40 characters wide, body about 70.

## 5. Layout, space and shape

- `--bk-gutter`: 28px. Side padding.
- `--bk-content`: 1120px. Max width of section content.
- `--bk-frame`: 1440px. Max width of the nav and full-bleed frames.
- `--bk-nav-h`: 64px. Nav height.
- `--bk-section-pt`: clamp(88px, 10vw, 144px). Section padding top.
- `--bk-section-pb`: clamp(88px, 9vw, 128px). Section padding bottom.
- `--bk-col-gap`: 64px. Gap between two columns.
- Spacing scale: 4px, 8px, 12px, 16px, 20px, 24px, 32px, 44px, 56px, 64px, 96px, 128px.
- Radius: xs 2px, sm 8px, md 12px, lg 16px, xl 18px, 2xl 24px, btn 12px. Buttons and inputs use `--bk-radius-btn`.
- Section pattern: label, headline, then a short lead to the right on desktop (`.bk-split`), stacking under 900px. Hairlines between rows rather than boxes.

## 6. Components (website classes)

Wrap the page in `<body class="bk">`, load `brand/tokens.css` then `brand/components.css`, then use:

| Class | What it is |
|---|---|
| `.bk-label` | UPPERCASE eyebrow with the marker. `.is-quiet` drops the marker and dims it. |
| `.bk-display`, `.bk-h2`, `.bk-h3`, `.bk-h4`, `.bk-stat` | Headlines. Wrap the setup in `<span class="bk-dim">` for two-tone. |
| `.bk-lead`, `.bk-body-lg`, `.bk-small`, `.bk-micro` | Text sizes. |
| `.bk-btn.is-primary` | Accent button. **One per view.** |
| `.bk-btn.is-solid` | Text-colour button: the nav button, important secondary actions. |
| `.bk-btn.is-ghost` | Outline button. `.is-sm` for the small size. |
| `.bk-link` | Inline link with an accent underline. |
| `.bk-chip`, `.bk-input`, `.bk-error` | Filters, inputs, error text. |
| `.bk-panel`, `.bk-window` + `.bk-window-bar` | Panels and browser frames for screenshots. |
| `.bk-section`, `.bk-container`, `.bk-split`, `.bk-frame` | Layout. |

Buttons say what happens: “Start reading”, “See a sample”. Never “Click here” or “Learn more”.

Icons: 16px grid, 1.6px stroke, round caps, no fills, `currentColor`. Use the set in `brand/icons/` (28: arrow-down, arrow-right, arrow-up-right, calendar, chart, chat, check, chevron-down, clock, close, download, globe, info, layers, link, lock, mail, menu, minus, pen, pin, play, plus, search, ticket, users, video, window).

## 7. Voice and copy

We sound like a well-read friend: warm, specific, a little playful, never preachy about productivity.

- **Words we use:** read, finish, remember, chapter, your shelf.
- **Words we never use:** hack, 10x, grind, unlock, revolutionary, AI-powered, game-changer, seamless.
- **Names:** Bookly in text, bookly (lowercase) in the logo, Bookly Inc. for legal.

Write like this:
- “Finish the book you started in March.”
- “Ten minutes a day. One chapter at a time.”
- “We read the boring bits so you don't have to.”

Not like this:
- “Unlock 10x knowledge with AI-powered reading hacks 🚀”
- “The ultimate productivity tool for high performers.”
- “Read 100 books a year!”

## 8. Logo

- Files: `brand/logo-on-light.svg`, `brand/logo-on-dark.svg`, `brand/logo-mark.svg` (square, for avatars and favicons).
- Always use the files. Clear space equal to the height of the first letter. Minimum width 72px.
- Never recolour it outside the palette, add effects, stretch it or set it in another font.
- The logo is currently the word “bookly” set in Fraunces. Outline it in a design tool before print.

## 9. Imagery

Real books, real hands, real reading corners. Warm daylight, linen and wood. Never stock 'success' photos or glowing brains.

Do:
- Books on tables, in hands, on trains.
- Warm natural light, muted colour.
- Close crops of pages and margins.

Don’t:
- AI-generated people or robots.
- Neon, gradients, glowing brains.
- Stacks of money, trophies, mountain summits.

If you generate a photo with an image model, prompt for: “documentary photo, warm window light, a person reading a paperback in a quiet corner, linen and wood tones, muted colour, shallow depth of field, no text, no logos”. Never ask an image model for text or logos; set type afterwards.

## 10. Recipes

### A web page or section

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;1,500;1,600&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="brand/tokens.css"><link rel="stylesheet" href="brand/components.css">
</head>
<body class="bk">
  <section class="bk-section">
    <div class="bk-container bk-split">
      <div>
        <span class="bk-label">Section label</span>
        <h2 class="bk-h2"><span class="bk-dim">Read less.</span> Remember more.</h2>
      </div>
      <p class="bk-lead">One or two plain sentences.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="bk-container" style="margin-top:56px">
      <a class="bk-btn is-primary" href="#">Start reading</a>
      <a class="bk-btn is-ghost" href="#">See a sample</a>
    </div>
  </section>
</body>
</html>
```

With Tailwind v4, import `brand/tailwind-theme.css` and use `bg-bk-bg text-bk-text font-sans`, `font-display` for headlines, `bg-bk-accent text-bk-on-accent`.

### Social posts

| Asset | Size |
|---|---|
| Feed post, carousel slide | 1080×1350 |
| Square post | 1080×1080 |
| Story, reel cover | 1080×1920 (keep the top 250px and bottom 340px clear) |
| Link preview (OG) | 1200×630 |
| LinkedIn banner | 1584×396 (text starts 30% from the left) |
| X header | 1500×500 |
| Avatar | 800×800, `logo-mark.svg` |
| YouTube thumbnail | 1280×720 |

Layout: 86px margin, label top left, two-tone headline in Fraunces about 96px, logo bottom left, slide number bottom right. One idea per post. Carousels: cover, point, list, proof, call to action. Mix light and dark posts; the accent stays small. Captions: the first line is the headline, one link, at most three hashtags, alt text on every image.

### Decks and documents

Decks: one headline per slide, a label and slide number, lots of space, 16:9. Documents, proposals and invoices: the light theme (#FAF6EE page, #1E2420 text), A4 or Letter, accent text in #1F7A55.

## 12. Check before you hand it over

- [ ] Only colours from section 3, only the fonts in section 4.
- [ ] One accent primary button per view, with #FFFFFF text on it.
- [ ] Sections start with a label; headlines follow the type scale.
- [ ] Text contrast at least 4.5:1 (use the pairs in section 3).
- [ ] Copy follows section 7; no banned words; every number is true.
- [ ] Works at 360px wide with no sideways scroll; respects reduced motion.

Run `node ai/check-brand.mjs <file>` on any HTML, CSS or SVG to catch off-brand colours, fonts, emoji and banned words.
